Let me parse the requirement card.

Document: ACX-STALL-103
Section: §4.55 — 失速特性与最小速度
Category: structural certification requirements (stall family)

Fields:
- family: label inside the Category parentheses before the word "family" → "stall"
- clause_no: Section identifier including § symbol and complete number, omit title → "§4.55"
- positive_load_limit: 3.38
- negative_load_limit: -0.75
- cycles_or_actions: 1000
- probability_per_hour: 1.7
- applies_to: sorted ascending: ["control-surface", "empennage", "engine-mount", "landing-gear"] — sorted: "control-surface", "empennage", "engine-mount", "landing-gear". Alphabetically: control-surface (c), empennage (e), engine-mount (e n g), landing-gear (l). Compare "empennage" vs "engine-mount": 'e' equal, 'm' vs 'n' — 'm' < 'n', so "empennage" < "engine-mount". So order: control-surface, empennage, engine-mount, landing-gear.
- compliance_methods: ["inspection", "simulation", "test"] sorted: inspection, simulation, test.
- amendment_year: 2016
